content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To clean up grease, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Apply heavy-duty degreaser to the main spill (10 minutes)
Step 2. Scrub the floor tiles with a stiff brush (15 minutes)
Step 3. Rinse the loosened grease with hot water (5 minutes)
Step 4. Squeegee the excess water into the floor drain (3 minutes)
Step 5. Locate the industrial-grade solvent (5 minutes)
Step 6. Put on protective rubber gloves (1 minute)
Step 7. Clear away large debris from the area (10 minutes)
Step 8. Sprinkle absorbent sawdust over the remaining slick (20 minutes)
Step 9. Agitate the solvent into the stubborn spots (8 minutes)
Step 10. Mop the area with a high-pH soap solution (12 minutes)
Step 11. Wipe down the lower cabinets with a damp cloth (6 minutes)
Step 12. Polish the stainless steel surfaces (15 minutes)
Step 13. Sanitize the cleaning tools (10 minutes)
Step 14. Dispose of the contaminated waste bags (5 minutes)
Step 15. Prepare a bucket of boiling water (7 minutes)
Step 16. Dry the floor with microfiber towels (10 minutes)
Step 17. Apply a slip-resistant floor treatment (20 minutes)
Step 18. Inspect the corners for missed residue (5 minutes)
Step 19. Buff the floor to a shine (15 minutes)
Step 20. Gather all used rags for laundering (4 minutes)
Step 21. Ventilate the room with high-powered fans (30 minutes)
Step 22. Order replacement degreaser supplies (5 minutes)
Step 23. Log the incident in the maintenance book (5 minutes)
Step 24. Steam clean the porous grout lines (25 minutes)
Step 25. Scrape off the thickest layers of sludge (12 minutes)
Step 26. Rinse the brush bristles (2 minutes)
Step 27. Check the overhead vent filters (10 minutes)
Step 28. Set up "Wet Floor" warning signs (2 minutes)
Step 29. Check the chemical inventory levels (5 minutes)
Step 30. Empty the vacuum canister (3 minutes)
Step 31. Fetch the long-handled scraper (2 minutes)
Step 32. Re-examine the spill perimeter (4 minutes)
Step 33. Dilute the concentrated cleaner (3 minutes)
Step 34. Soak the stubborn grease patches (15 minutes)
Step 35. Sweep up the saturated absorbent material (8 minutes)
Step 36. Spray a finishing deodorizer (2 minutes)
Step 37. Take photos of the cleaned area (3 minutes)
Step 38. Hand-scrub the baseboards (20 minutes)
Step 39. Sharpen the scraper blade (6 minutes)
Step 40. Mix a secondary cleaning solution (4 minutes)
Step 41. Hang the cleaning brush to dry (1 minute)
Step 42. Label the waste containers (2 minutes)
Step 43. Retrieve the heavy-duty mop (2 minutes)
Step 44. Move the kitchen equipment out of the way (15 minutes)
Step 45. Perform a final walkthrough with the supervisor (10 minutes)
Step 46. Inspect the mop head for cleanliness (2 minutes)
Step 47. Double-check the water temperature (1 minute)
Step 48. Refill the soap dispenser (3 minutes)
Step 49. Find the bag of sawdust (4 minutes)
Step 50. Unclog the spray nozzle (5 minutes)
Step 51. Wipe down the walls (15 minutes)
Step 52. Remove the floor mats (5 minutes)
Step 53. Test a small patch for discoloration (5 minutes)
Step 54. Organize the cleaning cart (10 minutes)
Step 55. Read the safety data sheet for the chemicals (10 minutes)
Step 56. Store the fans back in the closet (5 minutes)
Step 57. Check the drain for clogs (8 minutes)
Step 58. Vacuum the surrounding dry area (10 minutes)
Step 59. Apply a protective wax coating (30 minutes)
Step 60. Rinse the mop bucket (4 minutes)
Step 61. Identify the source of the grease leak (15 minutes)
Step 62. Seal the leak to prevent further spills (20 minutes)
Step 63. Put on a face mask (1 minute)
Step 64. Move the trash bins (2 minutes)
Step 65. Scour the metal legs of the tables (12 minutes)
Step 66. Pour an enzyme cleaner down the drain (5 minutes)
Step 67. Put on an apron (1 minute)
Step 68. Return the equipment to the storage room (10 minutes)
Step 69. Document the time of completion (1 minute)
Step 70. Steam the backsplash tiles (15 minutes)
